chunks: Blessed is He who revealed the Criterion
to His votary that it may be a warning for the world

key_terms.عَبْدِهِ: His servant, referring to the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.نَذِيرًا: A warner, one who gives warning of punishment
key_terms.ٱلْفُرْقَانُ: The Criterion, referring to the Quran as the standard that distinguishes between truth and falsehood

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being called Al-Furqan in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Al-Furqan' (The Criterion) is often interpreted as the Quran itself, but also extends to the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the living criterion distinguishing truth from falsehood. This verse underscores the universal scope of the Prophet's mission, emphasizing that divine guidance is not limited to a specific tribe but is a mercy and warning for all mankind. The revelation is thus seen as the ultimate standard (Furqan) by which all other claims to truth are measured.

en.ahmedali: BLESSED IS HE who revealed the Criterion (of right and wrong) to His votary
that it may be a warning for the world, --
en.ahmedraza: Most Auspicious is He Who has sent down the Furqan (the Criterion – the Holy Qur’an)
upon His chosen bondman for him to be a Herald of Warning to the entire world. (Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him – is the Prophet towards all mankind.)
en.arberry: Blessed be He who has sent down the Salvation
upon His servant, that he may be a warner to all beings;
en.daryabadi: Blest be He who hath revealed the Criterion
unto His bondman thathe may be unto the worlds a warner.
en.hilali: Who sent down the criterion (of right and wrong, i.e. this Quran) to His slave (Muhammad SAW) that he may be a warner to the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns).
en.itani: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion
upon His servant, to be a warning to humanity.
en.maududi: Highly blessed is He, Who has sent down Al-Furqan,
to His servant so that it may be a warner to all mankind:
en.mubarakpuri: Blessed be He Who sent down (Nazzala) the criterion
to His servant that he may be a warner to all nations.
en.pickthall: Blessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion
(of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples.
en.qarai: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion
to His servant that he may be a warner to all the nations.
en.qaribullah: Blessed is He who has sent down the Criterion
to His worshiper (Prophet Muhammad), that he is a warner to all mankind;
en.sahih: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion
upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
en.sarwar: Blessed is He who has revealed the criteria (for discerning truth from falsehood)
to His servant so that He could warn mankind.
en.shakir: Blessed is He Who sent down the Furqan
upon His servant that he may be a warner to the nations;
en.transliteration: Tab<u>a</u>raka alla<u>th</u>ee nazzala alfurq<u>a</u>na AAal<u>a</u> AAabdihi
en.wahiduddin: Blessed be He who has revealed the criterion [the Quran] to His servant
that he may warn the nations.
en.yusufali: Blessed is He who sent down the criterion
to His servant, that it may be an admonition to all creatures;-
